decisions.quote: We tested the reliability and reproducibility of our top genetic association findings in an independent non-overlapping young adult cohort. Our goal was to see if the results could be replicated in a cohort scanned on a different continent, with a different scanner field strength, and with a roughly 50-year difference in mean age.
decisions.reason: This study applies a gene-centric LASSO regression method to discover novel gene associations with temporal lobe volume in ADNI and then tests its own newly discovered top hit (MACROD2) in an independent young adult cohort. Under the codebook, replicating a new finding discovered within the same paper is not a replication of a previously published finding, and earlier GWAS results (Stein et al., 2010a) serve only as a methodological benchmark.
